section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Theft Deterrent System
title: INSPECTION OF LH KEY UNLOCK SWITCH CIRCUIT / INSPECTION OF RH KEY UNLOCK SWITCH CIRCUIT

content.text: E - INSPECTION OF LH KEY UNLOCK SWITCH CIRCUIT

content.description: Diagnostic flowchart for left-hand key unlock switch circuit inspection starting with turning ignition switch off, then checking diode continuity, then checking computer key unlock switch circuit

steps.label: DIODE
steps.test:
INSPECT DIODE CONTINUITY
Is diode of key unlock switch normal ?
(See page BE-67)

steps.label: COMPUTER
steps.test:
INSPECT KEY UNLOCK SWITCH CIRCUIT
Is there continuity between terminal 9 and body ground with LH door opened with key ?
steps.no_action: Open circuit in wire harness between terminal 9 of computer and terminal 1 of LH key unlock switch side diode.
